content.text: An invoice issued 2026-06-03 on Net 30 is nominally due 2026-07-03 (Friday). That is not a business day (2026-07-03 is Independence Day observed), so with following rolling it is due 2026-07-06 (Monday). That is 21 business days after issue on the federal calendar.
